skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and grasp the basic knowledge of healthcare, health insurance, and financing models.
Analyze and evaluate health insurance models and their impact on healthcare systems.
Develop critical thinking and analytical skills to assess health insurance policies and practices.
Collaborate effectively in group settings and demonstrate leadership skills.
Understand and comply with legal and regulatory frameworks related to health insurance.
Effectively present and communicate findings and analyses in both written and oral formats.
Conduct independent research and analyze data related to health insurance systems.
Understand and manage the operations of social and commercial health insurance systems.
Analyze and manage healthcare financing models and insurance funds.
Understand and evaluate health policies and their implementation in Vietnam and globally.
